divergence: All pass. The party name appears in file names of all three qualifying matters, so a file-name search (T0, T2) or a chunked extraction scan (T1) surfaced exactly those three early. Every run then spent several stages proving completeness (chunked or pooled scans, many hitting the 60 s limit; listings and reads of other surfaced matters the reviews named), read conflict memos, engagement letters and pleadings of the three matters, and wrote all three as adverse matters.
